rationale: Colin's deep experience in Web3 developer relations and ecosystem building at Consensys, combined with his current focus on AI infrastructure tooling, complements Darren's 30-year background in e-commerce systems and privacy-preserving blockchain architecture for KinkBNB. Darren is actively fundraising and building physical infrastructure in San Francisco, while Colin mentors on developer strategy and community-led adoption—both valuable as KinkBNB scales its web3 dApp and seeks operational/technical guidance alongside investment.
intro_message: Colin Nebius, meet Darren Mckeeman — you're both San Francisco-based builders in Web3 with deep infrastructure roots, and Darren's raising for KinkBNB's next phase while you mentor founders on ecosystem and devrel strategy.
